public_rationale: The claim's core is that a whole lot of students use LLMs for their papers and that coders use them a lot. Both hold in 2024 surveys. Stack Overflow's 2024 survey found 62% of developers already used AI tools in their work. A weighted HEPI survey of UK undergraduates, published February 2024, found 53% had used generative AI to help prepare assessments, and 13% used it to generate text for them. A Pew survey reported in January 2025 found 26% of US teens had used ChatGPT for schoolwork. HEPI's author also says students mostly use AI to help them study rather than to write whole essays, which weakens a strong reading. And no survey measures daily use. I did not score the hedged guess that most OpenAI users are students.
limitations: The result depends on reading 'write term papers' to include help with writing.
The hedged parenthetical about OpenAI's user base was not tested.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Many students, perhaps most of OpenAI's users, use LLMs daily to write term papers, and coders use them heavily too.

statement.excerpt: A whole lot of students (perhaps the majority of OpenAI’s users) use LLMs daily to write term papers; coders use it a lot too, as I often note.
statement.document_title: Hard-forked! Casey Newton’s distorted portrait of Gary Marcus and AI skepticism

from_speaker: use LLMs daily to write term papers
coders use it a lot too
our_interpretation: Plain reading: a large number of students use LLMs in writing their assessed papers, and a large share of programmers use AI tools in their work.
The parenthetical 'perhaps the majority of OpenAI's users' is openly hedged. I do not score it.
I read 'daily' loosely, as habitual use. No source measures how many students use LLMs daily for papers.
'Write term papers' is read to include using LLMs to help write or generate text for assessed work, not only submitting unedited AI text.
He named no period. I use calendar 2024 up to the post date, the latest period surveys before the post could report on.
criteria.support_condition: Surveys from 2024 show that a substantial share of students use generative AI for written assessments, and that a majority or large share of developers use AI tools in their work.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Surveys show only a small share of students using LLMs for written work, or only a small share of developers using AI tools.
